```json
    "budgetThreshold": 100.0
  }
}
```

## Why This Is Asked

- Row-Level Security (RLS)
- Customer-Managed Keys (CMK) in Key Vault
- Private Link / Private Endpoints
- Managed Identities
- GitHub Actions CI/CD
- Geo-redundant backups and Failover Groups
- Tenant onboarding/offboarding considerations

## Code Example

```sql
CREATE SECURITY POLICY dbo.TenantDataPolicy
ADD FILTER PREDICATE dbo.fnTenantPredicate(TenantId) ON dbo.TenantData
WITH (STATE = ON);
```

## Follow-up Questions

- How would you rotate CMKs and audit access?
- How would you handle per-tenant onboarding at scale?

Tests ability to design secure, multi-tenant data ingestion and governance on Azure with isolation, compliance, and automation.

- Data Factory or Synapse pipelines for ingestion
- ADLS Gen2 tenant isolation and folder RBAC

```json
{
  "name": "TenantIngest",
  "type": "Pipeline",

    "activities": [

       "inputs": [ {"name": "RawInput"} ],
       "outputs": [ {"name": "TenantRaw"} ]}

    "policy": {"tenantId": "${tenantId}"}
  }
}
```

- How would you validate data residency and retention policies per tenant?

## Why This Is Asked

Evaluate end-to-end IoT data pipelines, cross-tenant isolation, and governance in Azure.

## Key Concepts

- IoT Hub, Event Hubs, Spark on Synapse
- Cosmos DB per-tenant isolation, APIM, Private Endpoints
- Azure Lighthouse, Terraform, GitHub Actions
- CMK, RBAC, cost budgets, regional failover

## Code Example

```hcl
# per-tenant Cosmos DB account (illustrative)
resource "azurerm_cosmosdb_account" "tenant" {
  name                = "${var.tenant}-cosmos"
  location            = azurerm_resource_group.tenant.location
  resource_group_name = azurerm_resource_group.tenant.name
  kind                = "GlobalDocumentDB"
  offer_type          = "Standard"
  geo_location        = [{ location_name = azurerm_resource_group.tenant.location, failover_priority = 0 }]
}
```

## Follow-up Questions

- How would you validate DR RPO/RTO and perform failover testing?
- How would you add a new tenant with zero-downtime onboarding?
